title: Good App, Needs Better Notifications
body: The app is alright, but it needs more notifications to really help build habits. Also, swiping between habits is awkward since the controls are too high up.
author: javled

title: Básica y efectiva
body: Diseño bonito y gratuita. La uso todos los días para controlar hábitos. Muy recomendable.
author: luis.ceb

title: Beatiful and useful app
body: After trying many, many different habit trackers, this one is the only I seem to stick to. Even better, I’ve been using the free version which is awesome since you get unlimited habits and all non-cosmetic features other than the widgets. Fenomenal value. I would love to see an apple watch adaptation in the future, a simple interface where you could check off habits would be awesome 🙏
author: Felisinnn

title: BEST HABITS APP EVER
body: I discovered this app in Apple’s App Awards page. I have already completed 5 days of good habits and i have to say the app is amazing. Not only does it have the main functionalities you’d expect from a habit app such a calendar and reminders but most importantly, the app is BEAUTIFUL. The design, the music.. it really resonates within me and makes you keep completing habits. You have done an amazing job engineering team, and I am truly grateful that the app is free, otherwise I would had never tried it. I will probably upgrade to a premium tier, as I can really see the love and care for detailed you have put in the app. Thank you.
author: Nintendoalvaro
